prompts.workoutLight: Use case: stylized-concept, style-transfer. Asset: replacement 2:1 landscape cover for Inner Breeze's 7 Minute Workout practice. Reference image 1 is the old workout cover, which needs a fresh composition; reference image 2 is the breathing practice banner and is the exact illustration style to match. Draw a single fit adult woman with dark hair in a bun, jade-green athletic top, deep blue trousers and dark trainers, doing a clearly readable bodyweight squat in three-quarter view on an earth-brown woodland exercise terrace. Hands naturally joined in front of chest, hips back, feet planted. A quiet blue mountain lake and pale misty hills in the distance, pine branches only at far edges. Calm handmade 2D storybook illustration with subtle paper grain, softly shaded forms, crisp restrained contours like reference 2. Cool jade green and lake blue palette, brown ground, tiny light orange accent. One focal figure, strong figure/background contrast, keep whole figure in central half, all body parts comfortably within central horizontal 2:1 band. Soft clear daylight. Fresh setting and pose distinct from the old jumping-jack artwork. No text, numbers, clocks, UI, logos, watermarks, extra people or exercise equipment. Wide 2:1 framing.
prompts.astralLight: Use case: stylized-concept, style-transfer. Asset: replacement 2:1 landscape cover for Inner Breeze Astral Projection guided relaxation. Reference 1 is its old cover; reference 2 is the Meditation night banner and sets the handmade storybook drawing style. Make a new beautiful tranquil scene: a person lying safely asleep on a low earth-brown wooden bed beside an open veranda, pale blue translucent dream-self gently rising just above them, connected by one fine curved silver thread. Treat the sleeping person and corresponding dream-self as one central focal motif, naturally readable anatomy and peaceful face. Beyond the veranda a spacious teal lake, layered soft blue-green mountains and a few stars, pine silhouettes framing the extreme sides, small crescent moon. Light version: pale blue dawn sky still carrying a few stars, cool jade and blue base, brown bed, just one tiny light-orange accent on the blanket. Richer depth from overlapping mountain layers, delicate paper grain, softly shaded painterly 2D storybook forms matching reference 2; no plastic, glossy, photorealistic or hard neon look. Keep both entire figures and bed comfortably inside central 2:1 crop, with clear foreground/background contrast. No text, labels, numbers, clocks, UI, logos or watermarks. Wide 2:1 framing.
prompts.workoutDark: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the supplied 7 Minute Workout cover into its DARK THEME companion. Preserve precisely the same woman doing a squat, face, hands, body pose, clothing, shoes, landscape, camera, proportions, 2:1 composition and handmade storybook illustration style. Change only lighting/time: deep blue twilight sky with a few discreet stars and a small crescent, muted blue lake, jade pine shadows, softly moonlit figure and brown terrace. Keep the main figure clearly legible, pale skin and jade clothing distinct against the environment. Cool green-blue palette, no neon or glossy effects, no text, watermark or extra subjects.
prompts.astralDark: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the supplied Astral Projection cover into its DARK THEME companion. Preserve precisely the same sleeping person on the bed, translucent floating dream-self, silver thread, veranda, composition, anatomy, clothing and handmade storybook illustration style.
